grants.description: BIL - MULTILAYER MEMBRANE-ELECTRODE-SUBGASKET-PTL ASSEMBLY (MESPA) FOR FACILE ASSEMBLY OF PEM ELECTROLYSIS STACKS

THE OBJECTIVE OF THE PROJECT IS TO DEVELOP AND DEMONSTRATE A HIGH-VOLUME MANUFACTURING PROCESS FOR SOLID OXIDE ELECTROLYZER CELLS AND STACKS. THE OBJECTIVE OF BUDGET PERIOD 1 IS TO DEVELOP THE SPECIFICATIONS FOR THE HIGH-VOLUME MANUFACTURING PROCESS EQUIPMENT, DOWN-SELECT EQUIPMENT SUPPLIERS CAPABLE
